name: diagram-model
title: Diagram model
description: Diagram's data as plain functions on plain nodes, ports and edges: index a diagram, measure its bounds, move nodes and edge ends, check and add a connection, delete a selection (with what it leaves dangling), a card's anatomy measured from its text (nodeSize, edgeLabelSize), and the geometry of every connector (routes, curves, arrowheads, hit tests). Nothing renders; Diagram, Freeform's connectors and Interface Builder's segues run on it.
